Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s search results and incorrectly concluded that Lion Air’s base/hub was in Bangkok (Don Mueang), conflating Lion Air (Indonesia) with Thai Lion Air. This led toward the wrong country (Thailand) and former name (Siam), despite sources on the page indicating Jakarta/Soekarno-Hatta in Indonesia.
